Vision Government Solutions

|

HAMPTON,CT

|

Welcome

Welcome to the Town of
Hampton, Connecticut online assessment database.

Hampton has completed a revaluation for the Grand List of October 1, 2023.

The 2023 mill rate was set at 20.83.

The 2024 Grand List has been filed as of 1/28/25. A mill rate will not be set until budget approval late Spring 2025. For more information concerning budgets or the Board of Finance, visit the Town of Hampton website at www.hamptonct.org.

If you wish to appeal your assessment you may file an appeal with the Town of
Hampton’s Board of Assessment Appeals. Appeals to the Board of Assessment
Appeals must be filed on or before February 20, 2025. Petition forms are available from the Resources tab of the Assessor's page on the Town of Hampton website.

Property records are updated by our vendor, Vision Government Solutions, on a monthly basis, however pdf versions of the property card or "field card" are only updated once annually after the completion of dutites by the Board of Assessment Appeals in March.

Questions and concerns should be directed to the Assessor listed below.

CONTACT

ASSESSOR

JODY L. HEON, CCMAI

TELEPHONE

860 455-9132 EXT. 5 [tel:(860)%20455-9132]

EMAIL ADDRESS

ASSESSORS@HAMPTONCT.ORG [mailto:assessors@hamptonct.org]

HOURS

TUESDAYS: 9AM TO 4PM
THURSDAYS: 3PM-7PM

LOCATION

HAMPTON TOWN HALL

164 MAIN ST, HAMPTON, CT 06247

If you have any questions please call Vision customer support at 800-628-1013 x2.
